whyItMatters: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads an `allowInsecureConnections` switch set to true.
actions: Turn the control back on and fix what it reported instead of disabling the check. Specifically: fix an `allowInsecureConnections` switch set to true.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm nuget.config no longer carries an `allowInsecureConnections` switch set to true.
